## Definition of Done
- [ ] `flutter analyze` reports no issues, `flutter test` passes, and CI is green
- [ ] New behavior has unit or widget tests
- [ ] The code is formatted with `dart format`, with no `print` calls, commented-out code or unresolved TODOs
- [ ] New buttons have tooltips, so screen readers can announce them
- [ ] No API keys or tokens in the diff, logs or screenshots, and keys and `Authorization` headers are never logged
- [ ] Failures reach the user as friendly messages, never raw exceptions or stack traces
- [ ] Another teammate reviewed this PR
- [ ] `AI_passdown.md` is updated

## Acceptance
- [ ] The PO ran the card's Confirmation tests on this branch and ticked them on the issue
